abrogate.definitionKo: 조약, 법령, 계약, 약속 등의 효과를 없어지게 하다.
abrogate.englishDescription: To make a pact, statute, agreement, appointment, etc., become invalid.

accuser.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 범죄 사실을 경찰이나 법률 기관에 알려 범인을 처벌해 달라고 요구한 사람.
accuser.englishDescription: A person who reports someone's crime to the police or a law enforcement authority and asks them to punish the accused.

accuser.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 범죄 사실을 경찰이나 법률 기관에 알려 범인을 처벌해 달라고 요구한 사람.
accuser.englishDescription: A person who reports someone's crime to the police or a law enforcement authority and asks them to punish the accused.

adapt.definitionKo: 역사적 사실이나 소설을 고쳐서 연극이나 영화의 각본으로 바꾸어 쓰다.
adapt.englishDescription: To revise historical facts or novels and rewrite them as a script for plays or movies.

adapt.definitionKo: 어떠한 조건이나 환경에 익숙해지거나 알맞게 변화하다.
adapt.englishDescription: To get accustomed to, or change to fit into, a condition or environment.

adapt.definitionKo: 환경이나 변화에 알맞게 되어 익숙해지거나 체계, 명령 등에 순순히 따르다.
adapt.englishDescription: To get used to an environment or change, or obediently follow a system, order, etc.
To make something meet a requirement or reach a level.

adapt.definitionKo: 어떠한 조건이나 환경에 익숙해지게 하거나 알맞게 변화하게 하다.
adapt.englishDescription: To cause someone or something to get accustomed to, or change to fit into, a condition or environment.

admitting.definitionKo: 사람이나 물건 등을 일정한 장소나 시설에 모아 넣음.
admitting.englishDescription: The act of putting people, objects, etc., in a certain place or facility.

advocacy.definitionKo: 사상, 이론, 주의 등을 앞장서서 주장함.
advocacy.englishDescription: The act of strongly asserting a thought, theory, ideology, etc.

airing.definitionKo: 공기가 통함. 또는 공기가 통하게 함.
airing.englishDescription: The state of air passing through something, or an act of making air pass.

allies.definitionKo: 제일 차 세계 대전에서 독일, 이탈리아 등의 동맹국에 맞서기 위해 연합한 여러 나라.
allies.englishDescription: The nations allied to fight against Germany, Italy, etc., in World War I.

allies.definitionKo: 제이 차 세계 대전에서 전쟁을 일으킨 주된 나라와 맞서기 위해 연합한 여러 나라.
allies.englishDescription: The nations allied to fight against the central nations that began World War II.

allusion.englishDescription: A meaning or message hidden behind a certain behavior, text, etc., without being revealed outwardly.

annihilation.englishDescription: The act of eliminating everything that exists.
A state of ceasing to exist due to being death.

annihilation.definitionKo: 조직이나 집단이 완전히 해체되어 없어짐. 또는 무너져 없어지게 함.
annihilation.englishDescription: A state in which an organization or group is dispersed and terminated, or the act of making this happen.
Attacking and killing all or most of the enemy in a war or battle.

assignment.definitionKo: 회사나 학교 등에서 맡겨진 일이나 풀어야 할 문제.
assignment.englishDescription: A duty assigned or a problem to be solved in a company or at school.
An act of dividing up workload or handling the divided workload.
A given work or a task assigned to someone.

assignment.definitionKo: 권리, 의무, 이익 등을 알맞게 나누어 정하여 줌.
assignment.englishDescription: The act of assigning a duty, authority, profit, etc., for a particular purpose.
An act of dividing per share.

assignment.definitionKo: 사람을 어떤 부서에 배치하여 그곳에서 일하게 함.
assignment.englishDescription: The act of assigning a person to a department and making him/her work there.

assignment.definitionKo: 어떤 직위와 함께 맡을 일을 줌. 또는 그 직위.
assignment.englishDescription: The act of assigning someone to a position and giving him/her work to do, or the assigned position.

assignment.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 시키기 위하여 사람을 뽑음.
assignment.englishDescription: An act of assigning a certain task to someone.

assignment.definitionKo: 각자의 몫을 갈라 나눔. 또는 그 몫.
assignment.englishDescription: The act of dividing and assigning per share; or such a share.

auditor.definitionKo: 단체나 조직의 업무 등을 감독하고 어떠한 비리나 문제가 있는지 자세히 조사하는 일을 맡아보는 직원.
auditor.englishDescription: An officer who is responsible for overseeing the work of an organization and investigating any illegal activities or problems.

backseat.englishDescription: One's position that lags behind another's in a competition or learning.

benighted.englishDescription: Foolish without knowing how things are.

bibliography.englishDescription: An academic field that studies books.

birdhouse.englishDescription: A house in which a bird lives.

bitterly.englishDescription: With an unpleasant or bad feeling.

bitterly.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않아 기분이 썩 좋지 않은 듯한 모양.
bitterly.englishDescription: In the state of feeling somewhat displeased because something is not to one's liking.
In a state of being excessively severe.

blackmail.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 다른 사람에게 겁을 주거나 위협하다.
겁을 주고 위협하여 남에게 억지로 어떤 일을 하도록 함.
blackmail.englishDescription: An act of scaring and threatening another to do something against his/her will.

blackmail.definitionKo: 겁을 주고 위협하여 남에게 억지로 어떤 일을 하도록 하다.
blackmail.englishDescription: To scare and threaten another to do something against his/her will.

bleary-eyed.definitionKo: 졸리거나 술에 취해 눈빛이 멍하고 눈이 거의 감길 듯하다.
bleary-eyed.englishDescription: A person's eyes being dull and half-closed as if he/she is sleepy or drunk.

bounty.englishDescription: A sum of money paid to express gratitude.

bounty.definitionKo: 왕이나 윗사람이 신하나 아랫사람에게 준 물건.
bounty.englishDescription: Something given by a king or high-ranking person to his/her subjects or someone lower than himself/herself.

bounty.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 모으거나 구하거나 사람을 찾는 일 등에 돈이나 물품 등을 내걺. 또는 그 돈이나 물품.
bounty.englishDescription: An act of offering money or other prize in return for recruiting or finding something, or looking for a person; or the money or prize offered.

bounty.definitionKo: 무엇을 모집하거나 구하는 일, 또는 사람을 찾는 일 등에 내건 돈.
bounty.englishDescription: Money offered in return for recruiting or finding something, or looking for a person.

bullfighter.englishDescription: A person who fights a bull in a bullfight.

burying.englishDescription: Burying someone or something, or being buried deep in the ground.

buttocks.definitionKo: 앉았을 때 바닥에 닿는, 허리와 허벅지 사이의 살이 많은 신체 부위.
buttocks.englishDescription: The fleshy part between the waist and thigh that touches the floor when one is sitting.

buttocks.definitionKo: 앉을 때 바닥에 닿는 엉덩이의 아래 부분.
buttocks.englishDescription: The lower part of the buttocks that touches the floor when sitting.

buttocks.definitionKo: 뒤쪽 허리 아래, 허벅지 위의 양쪽으로 살이 불룩한 부분.
buttocks.englishDescription: The posterior protruding part below the waist and above the thighs.
The rear part of a body around the buttocks.

capsizing.englishDescription: The act of a ship coming to be laid on a rock.

carefully.englishDescription: In a thorough, careful, and composed manner.
In a thorough, careful, and composed manner.
In a very thoughtful and and careful manner.
Quietly and carefully so that no one notices.

carefully.definitionKo: 남이 모르도록 눈치를 보며 조심스럽게 조용히 자꾸 움직이는 모양.
carefully.englishDescription: A word describing one moving carefully, quietly, and repeatedly so that no one notices.

carefully.definitionKo: 작은 일에도 매우 꼼꼼하게 주의를 기울여 빈틈이 없게.
carefully.englishDescription: In a attentive and careful manner of doing a small thing, leaving nothing untouched.

carefully.definitionKo: 잘못이나 실수를 하지 않도록 말이나 행동 등에 주의를 하는 태도로.
carefully.englishDescription: With the attitude of being careful in speech, behavior, etc., not to make mistakes or errors.

carefully.definitionKo: 좋지 않은 일을 겪지 않도록 말이나 행동 등에 주의를 하며.
carefully.englishDescription: In a manner of being careful in speech, behavior, etc., not to get in trouble.

caution.definitionKo: 위험한 일을 조심하거나 삼가도록 미리 일러서 주의를 줌. 또는 그 주의.
caution.englishDescription: An act of cautioning someone in advance to be careful of or refrain from dangerous things, or such a caution.
The act of keeping something in mind and being careful about it.

caution.definitionKo: 옳지 않은 일 또는 잘못된 행동이나 생각을 하지 않도록 주의함.
caution.englishDescription: An act of taking precaution not to do something wrong, act improperly, or think improper thoughts.
A state of requiring special attention.

caution.definitionKo: 좋지 않은 일을 겪지 않도록 말이나 행동 등에 주의를 함.
caution.englishDescription: The act of being careful in speech, behavior, etc., not to get in trouble.

caution.definitionKo: 타일러서 앞으로 잘못이 없도록 주의를 줌. 또는 그런 말.
caution.englishDescription: An act of admonish someone not to repeat his/her wrongdoing in the future; or such a persuasive utterance.

caution.definitionKo: 타일러서 앞으로 잘못이 없도록 주의를 주다.
caution.englishExpression: discipline; admonish; caution; teach a lesson
caution.englishDescription: To admonish someone not to repeat his/her wrongdoing in the future.
The state of being very careful.

chan-gi.definitionKo: 반찬을 담는 접시나 종지 등의 그릇.
chan-gi.englishDescription: dish; bowl; plate: A container, such as a plate, bowl, etc., for holding a side dish

chattily.definitionKo: 하는 일 없이 자꾸 가벼운 이야기를 하며 노는 모양.
chattily.englishDescription: In the manner of continuously talking playfully without working.

chunhyangjeon.definitionKo: 조선 시대의 소설. 지은이와 지어진 시기는 알 수 없다. 기생의 딸인 성춘향과 양반 이몽룡의 사랑 이야기를 중심으로 춘향의 정절을 찬양하고 탐관오리의 횡포를 고발하고 있다.
chunhyangjeon.englishDescription: The Story of Chunhyang, a novel from the Joseon Dynasty; the author and period are unknown; it revolves around a love story between Sung Chunhyang, the daughter of a gisaeng, a Korean female entertainer, and Yi Mongryong, a man of noble birth; it exhorts her fidelity to her lover while criticizing the tyranny of corrupt bureaucrats.

closeness.definitionKo: 빈틈이나 잘못이 전혀 없을 만큼 엄격하고 세밀한 성질.
closeness.englishDescription: A quality of being strict and minute without any loopholes or errors.
A state in which a relationship becomes very close.
The state of a relationship with someone being very friendly and close
A very close and strong bond with someone.

cloudily.englishDescription: In the state of the weather or atmosphere being dark.

coding.definitionKo: 프로그램 언어를 써서 프로그램을 작성하는 일.
coding.englishDescription: Writing a program using a programming language.

colors.definitionKo: 색채가 있고 물이나 그 밖의 액체에 녹지 않는 고운 가루.
colors.englishDescription: Fine powder that has color and does not dissolve in water or other liquids.

communism.englishDescription: A political system in which property is owned communally.

communism.definitionKo: 모든 재산과 생산 수단을 사회가 공동으로 소유하여 계급의 차이를 없애는 것을 내세우는 사상.
communism.englishDescription: An ideology that argues for the elimination of class differences through communal ownership of all property and means of production.

complex.definitionKo: 조건이나 방법이 복잡하고 엄격하여 다루기가 쉽지 않다.
complex.englishDescription: Difficult to handle due to complicated and strict conditions and methods.

complex.definitionKo: 여러 가지가 서로 얽혀 있거나 어수선하여 갈피를 잡기가 어렵다.
complex.englishDescription: Hard to understand because several things are entangled or in disorder.

complex.definitionKo: 여러 가지가 서로 얽혀 있거나 어수선하여 갈피를 잡기가 어렵다.
complex.englishDescription: Hard to understand because several things are entangled or in disorder.

complex.definitionKo: 두 가지 이상의 물체가 합쳐져서 만들어진 물체.
complex.englishDescription: Something made by uniting more than two things.

complex.definitionKo: 두 가지 이상이 하나로 합쳐 있는.
complex.englishDescription: Two or more things being merged.

complex.definitionKo: 두 가지 이상이 하나로 합쳐 있는 것.
complex.englishDescription: A state in which more than two things have been united.

complex.definitionKo: 일, 감정 등이 정리하기 어려울 만큼 여러 가지가 얽혀 있다.
complex.englishDescription: Things, emotions, etc., being  too entangled to sort out.

concentration.definitionKo: 어떤 물질을 구성하는 성분들 중 일부를 없애 그 성질을 진하게 함.
concentration.englishDescription: A process of making the properties of a substance stronger by eliminating some elements of it.

concentration.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 해 낼 수 있는 힘을 한곳에 모음.
concentration.englishDescription: Pooling in one place the power to achieve something.

concentration.definitionKo: 어떤 대상에 생각이 쏠려서 온 마음을 기울여 열중함.
concentration.englishDescription: Paying much attention to one object or incident, not thinking of anything else.

concentration.definitionKo: 기체나 액체에 들어 있는 성분의 진한 정도.
concentration.englishDescription: A level of thickness of an element contained in gas or liquid.

concentration.definitionKo: 여러 가지 생각을 버리고 정신이나 마음을 집중함.
concentration.englishDescription: An act of pushing out many thoughts and making one’s mind or heart focus on something.

concentration.definitionKo: 한곳을 중심으로 하여 모임. 또는 그렇게 모음.
concentration.englishDescription: An act of gathering in a place, or an act of gathering things or people in a place.

concentration.definitionKo: 한 가지 일에 모든 힘을 쏟아부음.
concentration.englishDescription: An act of putting all one's energy into one thing.
The process of becoming smaller by being solidified into a mass.
The state of considering something especially important.

concentration.definitionKo: 마음이나 생각을 집중할 수 있는 힘.
concentration.englishDescription: The power to concentrate one's mind or thoughts.

concentration.definitionKo: 한곳을 중심으로 하여 모이게 됨. 또는 모이게 함.
concentration.englishDescription: The state of being gathered in a place, or the act of gathering in a place.

constitute.definitionKo: 여럿이 모여 어떤 성질이나 모양을 띤 것이 되게 하다.
constitute.englishDescription: To make several things gather to have a certain property or form a certain shape.

constitute.definitionKo: 어떤 특별한 뜻을 가지는 상태에 놓이다.
constitute.englishDescription: To be in a state that has a special meaning.

continuity.englishDescription: The state of going on without being disconnected.
The characteristic or state of being continued.

continuity.definitionKo: 끊이지 않고 계속 이어지는 성질이나 상태.
continuity.englishDescription: The property or state of going on without being disconnected.

continuity.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 상태를 오래 계속하는 성질.
continuity.englishDescription: The quality of continuing to do a certain act, or to be in a state for a long time.

conveyance.englishDescription: The act of carrying things, etc.

cottage.definitionKo: 평소에 머물러 사는 집이 아닌, 가끔 가서 쉬기 위하여 조용한 곳에 따로 지은 집.
cottage.englishDescription: A house built in a quiet place, which is for occasional vacations, not for residence.
A house in a rural area.

cousin.definitionKo: 부모님의 형제자매의 아들이나 딸과의 친족 관계. 또는 그런 관계에 있는 사람.
cousin.englishDescription: A kinship relationship with the son or daughter of one's parents' siblings. Or a person in such a relationship.

coverage.definitionKo: 한 방송국의 방송을 다른 방송국이 연결하여 내보내는 방송.
coverage.englishDescription: A show of a broadcaster relayed by another broadcaster.

coverage.definitionKo: 경기장이나 국회나 사건 현장 등 방송국 밖의 실제 상황을 방송국이 연결하여 전달하는 방송.
coverage.englishDescription: A broadcast show where the broadcaster brings a real situation from places such as a sporting venue, congress, the scene of an incident to the viewers or listeners.

coverage.definitionKo: 신문이나 잡지의 기사나 작품의 재료를 조사하여 얻음.
coverage.englishDescription: An act of examining and obtaining material for a story for a newspaper or a magazine or a written work.

coverage.definitionKo: 한 방송국의 방송을 다른 방송국에 연결해 내보냄.
coverage.englishDescription: The act of a broadcaster relaying a show of another broadcaster.

coverage.definitionKo: 경기장이나 국회나 사건 현장 등 방송국 밖의 실제 상황을 방송국에 연결해 방송함. 또는 그 방송.
coverage.englishDescription: The act of a broadcaster relaying an actual situation from places such as a sporting venue, congress or the scene of an incident to the viewers or listeners.

coverage.definitionKo: 어떤 무리나 범위에 함께 들어 있거나 함께 넣음.
coverage.englishDescription: An act of sending someone or putting something into a certain group or range.

cozily.englishDescription: In a manner of being small but petite and clean.
In the state of a thick object or seat being soft and warm.

cozily.definitionKo: 꽤 두꺼운 물건이나 자리가 부드럽고 따뜻하게.
cozily.englishDescription: In the state of a quite thick object or seat being soft and warm.

cuttlefish.definitionKo: 몸이 가늘고 길며 뒤 끝에 마름모 모양의 지느러미가 있고 다리가 짧은, 오징어의 한 종류.
cuttlefish.englishDescription: A type of squid that has short legs, and a thin, long body with a diamond-shaped fin at the edge.

daeseol.definitionKo: 일 년 중 눈이 가장 많이 내린다는 날로 이십사절기의 하나. 12월 8일경이다.
daeseol.englishDescription: One of the 24 seasonal divisions, said to have the heaviest snowfall of a year; it falls on around December 8th.

dalmaji.definitionKo: 대보름이나 추석 저녁에 산이나 들에 나가 달이 뜨기를 기다려 달에 소원을 비는 것.
dalmaji.englishDescription: An event of praying to the moon on a hill or in a field after waiting for the moon to come up in the evening of Daeboreum, First Full Moon Day,  or Chuseok, Korean Thanksgiving Day.

darkly.englishDescription: In the state of standing in a disorderly manner in darkness.

darkly.definitionKo: 사물을 분명히 알아볼 수 없을 정도로 어두운 모양.
darkly.englishDescription: In a manner of being so dark that one cannot discern an object clearly.

deceptiveness.definitionKo: 정신을 빼앗겨 올바르게 판단하지 못함. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
deceptiveness.englishDescription: A state of being seduced by something and unable to make a right judgment; or an act of making this happen.

decipherment.definitionKo: 어렵거나 잘 보이지 않는 문장이나 암호, 장면 등을 자세히 헤아리며 읽거나 판단함.
decipherment.englishDescription: An act of reading or deciding a difficult or indistinct sentence, code, scene, etc., by making an effort to understand its details.

decorous.definitionKo: 말이나 행동 등이 점잖고 무게가 있다.
decorous.englishDescription: One's way of speaking or behaving being decent and prudent.

definition.definitionKo: 내용, 성격, 의미 등을 분명하게 정함. 또는 그렇게 정해 놓은 것.
definition.englishDescription: The act of deciding content, principles, meanings clearly; or things that have been decided in such a manner.

definition.definitionKo: 어려운 낱말이나 글의 뜻을 알기 쉽게 밝혀 말함.
definition.englishDescription: The act of explaining the meaning of a difficult word or writing in a way that it is easy to understand.

definition.definitionKo: 어떤 말이나 사물의 뜻을 명확히 밝혀 분명하게 정함. 또는 그 뜻.
definition.englishDescription: The act of identifying and setting clearly the meaning of a word or object, or such a meaning.

denouement.englishExpression: end; finish; close; conclusion; result; outcome; ending; denouement
denouement.englishDescription: The ending of an event or story.
The very last part of an important event.

happiness.definitionKo: 어떤 대상으로 인해 얻게 되는 행복.

hardening.englishDescription: A state of becoming hard and solid.

hardening.englishDescription: The act of heating metal such as iron in fire and putting it in water to cool it in order to harden it.

hearsay.definitionKo: 여러 사람 입에 오르내리며 확실한 근거 없이 떠도는 소문.

him.definitionKo: 여자가 다른 사람에게 그 자리에 없는 자기 남편이나 애인을 가리키는 말.
him.englishDescription: A pronoun used by a female when indicating her husband or boyfriend who is not there currently to another person.

hm.definitionKo: 당황스럽거나 어떻게 할지 결정하지 못했을 때에 하는 혼자 하는 말.

hm.definitionKo: 상대방의 말이나 행동이 마음에 들지 않아 불평을 할 때 쓰는 말.

hm.englishDescription: An exclamation used when showing an uncertain attitude toward someone's question or demand.

hm.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않거나 짜증이 날 때 하는 말.

hm.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않거나 걱정스러울 때 하는 소리.

hotpacking.englishDescription: Applying a cloth soaked in hot water or a bag filled with ice to a sore spot to treat an illness.

pasting.definitionKo: 종이 등을 붙이려고 무엇에 풀을 바르는 일.
pasting.englishDescription: An act of applying glue or paste to attach a piece of paper, etc. to something.

patrol.englishDescription: A soldier watching an area for a possible invasion or accident.

patrol.definitionKo: 재해나 범죄 등을 예방하기 위하여 여러 곳을 돌아다니며 사정을 살핌.
patrol.englishDescription: The act of passing around different places and keeping an eye out to prevent disasters, crimes, etc.

patrol.englishDescription: To pass around different places and keep an eye out to prevent disasters, crimes, etc.

pedal.definitionKo: 악기나 기계 등을 작동시키는 발로 밟는 부분.
pedal.englishDescription: The part of a musical instrument or machine, etc., that one presses with a foot to operate it.

pedal.definitionKo: 발로 밟거나 눌러서 기계나 악기 등을 작동시키는 부품.
pedal.englishDescription: A component of a machine, musical instrument, etc., that operates the whole body by being stepped on or pressed with a foot.

perplexed.definitionKo: 곤란한 처지가 되어서 어찌해야 할지 몰라 난처하다.
perplexed.englishDescription: Feeling worried, not knowing what to do in a puzzling situation.

perplexed.definitionKo: 갑작스럽거나 혼란스러워서 정신이 흐리고 어리둥절한 느낌이 있다.
perplexed.englishDescription: Feeling stupefied and dazed because something is sudden or confusing.

petroleum.definitionKo: 땅속에서 천연으로 나며 태워서 에너지를 만드는, 주로 자동차나 공장의 연료로 쓰는 검은색의 기름.
petroleum.englishDescription: Black oil that sprouts naturally from the ground and is used to make energy by burning; it is usually used as fuel of cars or factories.

philology.definitionKo: 문헌 자료를 통해 한 민족이나 시대의 문화를 역사적으로 연구하는 학문.
philology.englishDescription: An academic area that studies the culture of an ethnic group or an era through documents.

piggyback.definitionKo: 주로 사람을 남의 등에 올려 떨어지지 않게 하다.
piggyback.englishDescription: To put one person on another person's back and prevent him/her from falling.

plow.englishDescription: To turn over the soil on farmland with agricultural implements.
A farm implement used to break up soil on rice paddies and fields.

pocket.definitionKo: 남의 물건이나 돈을 옳지 않은 방법으로 자신의 것으로 만들다.
pocket.englishDescription: To take the possessions or money of others in a wrongful way.

pocket.definitionKo: 사람 또는 물건을 몰래 빼내어 다른 곳으로 보내거나 감추다.
pocket.englishDescription: To take a person or thing out secretly and hide or send him/her or it to another place.

pocket.definitionKo: 옷에 천 등을 덧대어 돈이나 물건 등을 넣을 수 있도록 만든 부분.
pocket.englishDescription: A part made of cloth, etc., that is attached to a piece of garment for keeping money, things, etc., in.

pocket.definitionKo: 남의 것을 빼앗아 자기 것으로 만들다.
pocket.englishDescription: To steal something from another person and make it one's own.

pocket.definitionKo: 옷에 천 등을 덧대어 돈이나 물건 등을 넣을 수 있도록 만든 부분.
pocket.englishDescription: A part made of cloth, etc., that is attached to a piece of garment for keeping money, things, etc., in.

policing.definitionKo: 사회의 질서를 지키고 국민의 안전과 재산을 보호하는 일. 또는 그러한 일을 맡은 국가 기관.
policing.englishDescription: The act of keeping order in society and protecting people and property from crimes; or a government agency in charge of such tasks.

pomegranate.definitionKo: 빨갛고 단단한 껍질 속에 새콤달콤한 분홍빛의 작은 알갱이가 가득 들어 있는 둥근 열매.
pomegranate.englishDescription: A round fruit that has small sour and sweet pink grains in its solid, red skin.

portray.definitionKo: 어떤 대상을 있는 그대로 자세하게 말이나 글로 표현하거나 그림으로 그리다.
portray.englishDescription: To give a detailed account of a certain object in spoken or written words, or express it in painting as it stands.

positive.definitionKo: 동양 철학에서, 세상을 이루는 두 성질 가운데에서 적극적이고 능동적인 것.
positive.englishDescription: The more active and aggressive of the two fundamental elements that constitute the world in Eastern philosophy.

positive.definitionKo: 머리로 깊이 생각하고 따져서 증명하는 것이 아니고, 경험, 관찰, 실험 등에 따라 적극적으로 증명하는.
positive.englishDescription: Proving a fact through experiences, observations, experiments, etc., not through thinking alone.

positive.definitionKo: 어느 편에 유리하게 해석하는 데가 있다.
positive.englishDescription: Interpreting something in a way that is favorable to one side.

pragmatism.definitionKo: 실제적으로 쓸모가 있는 지식과 사고만이 진리로서의 가치가 있다고 주장하는 철학 사상.
pragmatism.englishDescription: A philosophical ideology insisting that only practical knowledge and thinking are worthy as truth.

processability.definitionKo: 기술이나 힘 등에 의해 원료나 재료가 새로운 제품으로 만들어질 수 있는 성질.
processability.englishDescription: The ability of raw materials or materials to be made into new products, by using technology or power.

producer.definitionKo: 사람이 생활하는 데 필요한 물건을 만드는 사람.
producer.englishDescription: A person who makes things that people need to live.

producer.definitionKo: 영화, 연극, 방송 등에서 기획과 제작에 관한 모든 것을 책임지는 사람.
producer.englishDescription: A person who is responsible for everything related to the planning and production of a film, play, broadcast, etc.

profile.englishDescription: The outline of a face when viewed from the side.
One's brief personal record that contains important information.

profile.definitionKo: 기계나 구조물의 옆면에서 바라본 상태를 평면으로 나타낸 도면.
profile.englishDescription: A planar drawing made by describing a machine or structure as seen from the side.
The face of someone seen from the side.

profiteer.definitionKo: 온갖 좋지 않은 방법으로 자신의 이익만을 꾀하는 사람. 또는 그런 무리.
profiteer.englishDescription: A person who seeks his/her profits with all kinds of bad methods, or such a group.

proliferate.definitionKo: 늘어서 많아지다. 또는 늘려서 많게 하다.
proliferate.englishDescription: To grow or multiply; to cause to grow or multiply.

proliferate.englishExpression: spread; be dispersed; be diffused; proliferate

provokingly.definitionKo: 자꾸 밉살스럽게 이야기하거나 비웃는 태도로 놀리는 모양.

pyeon.definitionKo: 사람이 오고 가거나 물건을 부치는 데 이용하는 기회나 수단.
pyeon.englishDescription: A bound noun used to mean an opportunity or means used by a travelling person to send a parcel.

pyeon.definitionKo: 형식이나 내용, 성질 등이 다른 글을 구별하여 나타내는 말.
pyeon.englishDescription: A bound noun used to separately indicate a piece of writing in a specific form, content, characteristic, etc.

pyeon.definitionKo: 책이나 문학 작품, 또는 영화나 연극 등을 세는 단위.
pyeon.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit to count books or literary works, or movies, plays, etc.

pyeon.definitionKo: 책의 내용을 일정한 단위로 크게 나눈 한 부분을 나타내는 말.
pyeon.englishDescription: A bound noun used to indicate a part of the content of a book, which has been divided in large chunks of a regular size.

quantitative.englishDescription: Being based on the number and quantity of something.

quantitative.definitionKo: 세거나 잴 수 있는 것과 관계된.
quantitative.englishDescription: Related to something countable or measurable.

racism.definitionKo: 인종마다 타고나는 소질과 능력에 차이가 있다고 하여 다른 인종을 못살게 굴거나 차별하는 일 등을 정당화하는 사고방식.
racism.englishDescription: A way of thinking that asserts differences in innate talents and abilities of races, leading to the justification of tormenting or discriminating other races.

rank.englishDescription: An individual's role or position within a society.

rank.englishDescription: A status or rank given institutionally to an individual in a feudal society.

rank.definitionKo: 군대나 경찰과 같은 조직 내에서의 지위나 관직 등의 등급.

Someone's rank or position based on his/her social class.

rank.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 어떤 일을 해야 하는 상황이나 지위.
rank.englishDescription: (slang) A situation or a position which must do something.

rank.definitionKo: 기름기 많은 짐승의 고기에서 비위에 거슬리는 역겨운 냄새나 맛이 나다.
rank.englishDescription: The fatty meat of an animal smelling or tasting disgusting and nauseating.

rank.englishDescription: A long line formed by a number of people standing in a row.

rank.englishDescription: The state of being high or low, or good or bad, displayed in multiple hierarchy levels.

rank.definitionKo: 다른 사람이나 조직이 인정하는 높은 지위나 등급.
rank.englishDescription: A high status or rank recognized by other people or organization.

A rank of position or a grade of skill within an organization.

rank.englishDescription: To line up in order of high to low values or positions; to make something become that way.

rashness.definitionKo: 앞으로의 일에 대해 미리 생각하거나 정한 것이 없음.
rashness.englishDescription: The trait of not having planned or thought about the things that lie ahead.

ratification.definitionKo: 조약이 맺어지는 것에 대하여 대통령이나 국가가 최종적으로 확인하고 동의하는 것.

rationalism.definitionKo: 진정한 인식은 경험이 아니라 태어날 때부터 가지고 있는 이성에 의하여 얻어진다고 보는 이론.
rationalism.englishDescription: A theory that true realization comes from one's innate reason, not from one's experiences.

rationalism.definitionKo: 논리나 이치에 알맞게 생각하고 판단하는 태도나 사고방식.
rationalism.englishDescription: A way of thinking or an attitude of thinking and making a judgment according to logic or reason.

re-discuss.definitionKo: 이미 논의가 끝난 문제를 다시 논의하다.
re-discuss.englishDescription: To discuss again an issue that has already been discussed.

realities.englishDescription: The state of something as it is.

reassuringly.definitionKo: 무엇에 대한 믿음으로 의지가 되고 마음이 놓이게.
reassuringly.englishDescription: In such a manner that makes someone feel secure and rely on someone on the basis of trust in him/her.

recently.englishDescription: A period from a while ago to the present.

reconstruction.englishDescription: An act of renovating and rebuildingn a building or facilities.

reconstruction.englishDescription: The act of repeating an action or work that has already been performed.

recycling.definitionKo: 버리게 된 물건을 모아 새로운 것을 만들어 씀.
recycling.englishDescription: The act of collecting discarded items and turning them into something new for further use.

recycling.definitionKo: 쓰고 버리는 물건을 다른 데에 다시 사용하거나 사용할 수 있게 함.
recycling.englishDescription: The act of using discarded items or making them useful for other purposes.

refined.definitionKo: 행동, 취미 등의 수준이 높고 품위가 있다.

refined.definitionKo: 사람의 외모나 말, 행동 등이 침착하고 점잖다.
refined.englishDescription: Calm and gentle in one's appearance, speech, behavior, etc.

refined.definitionKo: 글이나 말, 곡선 등이 거침없이 미끈하고 아름답다.
refined.englishDescription: A piece of writing, remark, curved line, etc., being smooth and elegant.

registration.definitionKo: 땅이나 집 같은 부동산에 대한 권리 관계를 법정 절차에 따라 등기부에 기록하는 일. 또는 그런 기록.
registration.englishDescription: The act of recording on the register the rights or factual grounds of an individual's property such as land or house according to a legal documentation process, or such a record.

registration.definitionKo: 허가나 인정을 받기 위해 이름 등을 문서에 기록되게 하는 것.
registration.englishDescription: The act of registering a name, etc., in a document in order to receive a permit or acknowledgment.

registration.definitionKo: 학교나 학원 등에서 어떤 과목을 등록함.

reimport.definitionKo: 이전에 수출했던 물건을 다시 그 나라로부터 수입함.
reimport.englishDescription: The act of importing goods prevously exported to another country.

resolution.definitionKo: 마음을 단단히 먹음. 또는 그 마음.

resolution.definitionKo: 마음속으로 일을 어떻게 하기로 결정함. 또는 그런 결정.

resolution.definitionKo: 어려운 일이나 좋지 않은 상태를 해결하여 없애 버림.
resolution.englishDescription: An act of addressing and getting rid of a difficult problem or unfavorable situation.

resonance.definitionKo: 물체가 외부로부터의 음파에 자극되어 그와 동일한 진동수의 소리를 냄.
resonance.englishDescription: An object making freqency sounds the same as the sound waves of an outside stimulus.

review.definitionKo: 어떤 물건이나 현상을 보거나 듣고 나서 느낀 것을 쓴 글.
review.englishDescription: A piece of writing about one's feelings from seeing or hearing an object or phenomenon.
The act of going over what has been learned.
To go over what has been learned.

review.definitionKo: 공식적인 행사나 공연 작품, 발표회 등에 대하여 종합적으로 분석하고 평가하는 것.

review.definitionKo: 공식적인 행사나 공연 작품, 발표회 등에 대하여 종합적으로 분석하고 평가하다.
review.englishDescription: To conduct a comprehensive analysis and evaluation on an official event, performance, recital, etc.

review.englishDescription: To review and analyze certain facts or information in depth.

review.definitionKo: 문서의 내용 중에 잘못된 것을 바로잡음.
review.englishDescription: The act of correcting errors in a document.

review.definitionKo: 어떤 글이나 말, 사건 등에 대해 옳고 그름이나 좋고 나쁨 등을 판단하여 드러내 알림. 또는 그런 비평.
review.englishDescription: Judging and disclosing whether a remark, written statement, incident, etc. is right, wrong, good, bad, etc., or this kind of criticism.

review.definitionKo: 예술 작품이나 제품 등에 대한 생각이나 느낌, 또는 평가.
review.englishDescription: Thoughts, feelings, or evaluations about a work of art, product, etc.

suffering.definitionKo: 몸이나 마음이 고통스러운 상태. 또는 그런 느낌.
suffering.englishDescription: The state of being in pain physically or emotionally, or this feeling.

suffering.definitionKo: 몸이나 마음이 편하지 않고 아프고 고통스럽다.
suffering.englishDescription: Feeling pain in one's body or mind.
The act of suffering an unbearable experience.
An extremely worrying and painful situation.

suffrage.definitionKo: 선거에 참가하여 투표할 수 있는 권리.
suffrage.englishDescription: The right to participate in an election and vote.

suffrage.definitionKo: 국민이 정치에 참여할 수 있는 권리.
suffrage.englishDescription: The right of the people to participate in politics.

sugar.definitionKo: 포도당, 과당, 전분 등 물에 잘 녹으며 단맛이 있는 탄수화물.
sugar.englishDescription: A carbohydrate that melts well in water and has sweetness, such as glucose, fructose, starch, etc.

sugar.definitionKo: 물에 잘 녹으며 음식의 단맛을 내는 데 쓰는 하얀 가루.
sugar.englishDescription: White powder that dissolves easily in water and is used to sweeten food.

tactician.englishDescription: A person who is good at developing tactics.

tangle.englishDescription: To be entangled in this way and that.

tangle.definitionKo: 끈이나 줄 등이 이리저리 엇갈려서 묶이거나 감기다.
tangle.englishDescription: For strings, ropes, etc., to be bound or wrapped in this way and that.

tangle.definitionKo: 실이나 줄 등을 풀기 힘들게 서로 엉키게 하다.
tangle.englishDescription: To make thread, strings, etc., entangled so much that it can hardly be disentangled.

tangle.definitionKo: 실이나 줄 등이 풀기 힘들게 서로 한데 얽히다.
tangle.englishDescription: For thread, strings, etc., to be entangled so much that it can hardly be disentangled.

tangle.definitionKo: 실이나 줄 등이 풀기 힘들게 서로 한데 얽히다.
tangle.englishDescription: For thread, strings, etc., to be entangled so much that it can hardly be disentangled.

tangle.definitionKo: 가늘고 긴 실이나 줄 등을 풀기 힘들 정도로 얽히게 하다.
tangle.englishDescription: To make thin, long threads or strings entwined to such an extent that they cannot be untied.

tangle.definitionKo: 가늘고 긴 실이나 줄 등을 풀기 힘들 정도로 얽어 놓다.
tangle.englishDescription: To make thin, long threads or strings entwined to such an extent that they cannot be untied.

teleology.definitionKo: 모든 사물이나 현상은 목적에 의하여 규정되고 목적을 실현하기 위하여 있다는 이론.
teleology.englishDescription: A theory that all things or phenomena are defined by their purposes and they exist to meet such a purpose.

tempt.definitionKo: 듣기 좋거나 믿음이 가는 말을 하여 어떤 일을 하도록 부추기다.
tempt.englishDescription: To talk somebody into doing something by saying something that is good to hear or is trustworthy.

tempt.definitionKo: 듣기 좋은 말이나 행동으로 다른 사람을 속이거나 부추겨서 자기가 바라는 대로 하게 하다.
tempt.englishDescription: To make another person do as one wishes by deceiving or tempting him/ her with pleasant words or actions.

thigh.englishDescription: The part of the leg above the knee.
The thick-fleshy part of the inside the thigh.

to.englishDescription: The word used to indicate the range "from something to something".
A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement refers to a limited category.
A postpositional particle to indicate that something is added to the preceding statement.

to.definitionKo: 앞말이 목적지이거나 어떤 행위의 진행 방향임을 나타내는 조사.
to.englishDescription: A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement refers to a destination or the course of a certain action.

to.definitionKo: 앞말이 어떤 행위나 작용이 미치는 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
to.englishDescription: A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement is the subject to which a certain action or operation is applied.

toenmaru.definitionKo: 큰 마루의 바깥쪽에 좁게 만들어 놓은 마루.
toenmaru.englishDescription: A type of traditional Korean narrow wooden veranda made up of floorboards, which runs along the perimeter of the main floor.

topography.englishDescription: The surface features of a place.

translation.definitionKo: 원문의 단어, 구절, 문장 등을 다른 언어로 번역함. 또는 그런 번역.
translation.englishDescription: An act of translating an original text's words, phrases, sentences into another language, or such a translation.

translation.definitionKo: 어떤 언어로 된 글을 다른 언어의 글로 바꾸어 옮김.
translation.englishDescription: The act of translating speech or writing into another language.

translation.definitionKo: 어떤 언어로 된 글을 다른 언어의 글로 바꾼 문장.

translation.definitionKo: 어떤 언어로 된 글을 다른 언어의 글로 바꾸어 놓은 작품이나 책.
translation.englishDescription: A literary work or book in a language that was translated from another language.

translation.definitionKo: 어떤 언어로 된 글을 다른 언어의 글로 바꾸어 놓은 책.
translation.englishDescription: A book in a language that was translated from another language.

translation.definitionKo: 어떤 언어로 된 글을 다른 언어의 글로 바꾸어 출판한 책.

treasuring.englishDescription: The act of guarding and taking care of someone or something precious.

triumvirate.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어울려 다니면서 친하게 지내는 세 사람.
triumvirate.englishDescription: (figurative) A group of three people who are on close terms and hang around together.

tt.definitionKo: 한글 자모 'ㄷ'을 겹쳐서 쓴 글자. 이름은 '쌍디귿'으로, 'ㄷ'의 된소리이다.
tt.englishDescription: The consonant in the Korean alphabet consisting of double 'digeut', which creates a stronger sound than a single 'digeut'.

umpire.definitionKo: 운동 경기에서, 규칙을 지키고 어기는 것이나 승부를 가려내는 사람. 또는 그런 일.
umpire.englishDescription: A person who judges who wins or loses, and whether a rule has been violated or not in a sports game; such a job.

umpire.definitionKo: 운동 경기에서, 규칙을 지키고 어기는 것이나 승부를 가려내다.
umpire.englishDescription: To judge who wins or loses, and whether a rule has been violated or not in a sports game.

underground.definitionKo: 정부에 반대하거나 법에 어긋나는 일을 드러나지 않게 숨어서 하는 영역.
underground.englishDescription: An act of secretly doing activities against the government or the law.

unenthusiastic.definitionKo: 행동, 태도, 관계 등이 분명하지 않고 흐리다.
unenthusiastic.englishDescription: Behavior, an attitude, relation, etc., being vague, not clear.

unenthusiastic.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않거나 못마땅하여 내키지 않는 듯하다.
unenthusiastic.englishDescription: Seeming that someone has no mind to do something because he/she does not like it.

unfold.englishDescription: For a work to start and make progress.

To lay out and expand on details.
To spread out in width or length.
For something folded or overlapped to be spread widely.

unicorn.definitionKo: 이마에 한 개의 뿔이 달려 있고 말처럼 생긴, 인도와 유럽의 전설에 나오는 상상 속의 동물.
unicorn.englishDescription: An imaginary animal from Indian and European legends, with a horn on its forehead, looking like a horse.

unintelligent.englishDescription: Looking a bit stupid, not smart.
Not wise and having a dull mind.

unsure.englishDescription: Unclear whether something is or not.

unwaveringly.englishDescription: Without being daunted under any circumstances because one's will is strong.

unwaveringly.definitionKo: 마음이나 의지, 약속 등이 쇠와 돌처럼 매우 굳고 단단하게.
unwaveringly.englishDescription: In the manner of one's mind, will, word, etc., being very firm and steadfast just like iron and stone.

unwaveringly.definitionKo: 어떤 어려운 일이 있어도 흔들리지 않고 그대로.
unwaveringly.englishDescription: In an unshakable and firm manner even if there is an adversity.

user.definitionKo: 어떤 물건이나 시설, 제도 등을 이용하는 사람.

user.englishDescription: A person who uses a certain facility, means of transportation, etc.

user.definitionKo: 사람, 사물, 정보 등을 선택하여 사용하는 사람.
user.englishDescription: A person who selects and uses services, objects, information, etc.

usually.englishDescription: In the manner of making nothing of doing something as if it was nothing special.

veil.definitionKo: 막거나 감추어 보이거나 통하지 않게 되다.
veil.englishDescription: To block or hide something so as to prevent it from being visible or connected to something else.

veil.definitionKo: 숨김없이 모두가 있는 그대로 드러나다. 또는 숨김없이 모두를 있는 그대로 드러내다.

veil.englishDescription: For everything to be revealed outright; or to reveal everything outright.

vineyard.englishDescription: A yard where grapes are planted and grown.

voice.englishDescription: A human voice or sound of speech.

voice.definitionKo: 목구멍 가운데에 있는, 소리를 내는 기관.
voice.englishDescription: An organ in the center of the throat that is used to produce sound.

voice.definitionKo: 의견을 말하는 것에 대한 권위나 영향력.

voice.definitionKo: 기계를 통하지 않고 사람이 직접 말하는 목소리.
voice.englishDescription: The voice directly coming out of a person, not via a machine.

wait-and-see.definitionKo: 형편이나 분위기 등에 간섭하지 않고 멀리서 보기만 하는.
